infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Plusveda uses the camera to scan barcodes and read the batch number on medicine packs, and to photograph supplier bills and cheques, for example to add a strip of paracetamol to a sale in one scan.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plusveda uses your photo library to import a picture of a supplier bill or cheque you have already taken, so its details can be filled in for you.
